name: plugins
description: Michael Assaf's Claude plugins: thinkr (plan and explainer pages as Artifacts), guided-review (guided code reviews as Artifacts) and e-rust (Effective Rust).

plugins.name: thinkr
plugins.description: Plan and explainer pages as Claude Artifacts: questions whose answers go back to Claude, stepped diagrams, WebGPU figures, motion and quiet UI sound, in the default shadcn/ui look.

plugins.name: guided-review
plugins.description: Guided code reviews as Claude Artifacts: an overview with a before / after of the behavior, then the diff as short chapters, each explained beside its code, with review marks, a file tree and syntax-highlighted diffs.

plugins.name: e-rust
plugins.description: Effective Rust: defaults for reading and writing Rust: toolchain, imports and modules, types and invariants, conversions, ownership, documentation and unsafe code, tests, plus standard-library and nightly guidance.
